notes.title: JJR 1.11 Update and SALE!
notes.notes:
Hi Guys, we're happy to release the latest update to JJR, that includes new PvP Arena and Race Modes. The game is also currently $4.94 so please go pick it up if you've been putting it off!

Arena Modes
Get The Cookie 
Battle with your friends to collect Cookies around the level, and bring them back to feed the Piggy Bank for points. Don't get killed, or you'll drop your cookies! 

Death Match 
Classic Death Match, first to 5 kills wins. The best defence is a good offence, kill or be killed! 

Territories 
Capture Territories to earn points, and defend it against aggressors. Defence is key in this one! 

Race Modes
Race with up to 4 players on 16 different courses to determine the fastest Dino in the Galaxy! 

Changes
Added a new "Kick Flip" move, mapped to Shoulder Buttons on the controller. This is most useful for PvP, but also can be used in the main campaign to defend yourself against projectiles, or reflect items. 
Changes to Co-Op Design - Players are now in a 'ghost' state when dead, and will respawn automatically after a few seconds. 
Re-balanced several of the later levels, smoothing out the spikes in the difficulty curve. 
Added 2 New Levels to add a bit more length to the campaign. 
Reduced Prices on Hats / Heads 
Cleared leaderboards for a few of the levels, and the Adventure, RageQuit & Speedruns 
Fixed bug with “Better Together” Achievement

Upcoming:
We're aware of the black screen bug, as well as co-op spawning and linux issues and are looking into it! Thanks for your patience :D

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.4
notes.notes:
In the latest builds we've fixed a number of small bugs, mainly with regards to local co-op.

Changes include:
* Co-Op Fix: Players could lose control after collecting a secret item 
* Co-Op Fix: Players can get stuck in Floor when warping to Finish Line.
* Co-Op Fix: Warps can not be triggered while collecting a Secret Item
* Fix: Broken Title Screen w/ Pink Squares
* Controller Support: Updated InControl Additional Controller Profiles Added

We've also fundamentally changed the way that Co-Op works. We've gotten rid of the checkpoint-respawn system, and now, when you die, you will be turned into a ghost. You can still move around, but can't interact with the world or collect coins. 

After 5 seconds, you regain full control of your character. Only if all players dia at once, will you need to restart at a checkpoint.

The main reason we did this was to improve the 'flow' of co-op, we found it could be quite boring waiting to respawn, especially in Boss fights, or in smaller challenge rooms that don't have many checkpoints.

As always, let us know what you think in our forums:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/329460/discussions/0/617336568072963774/

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.2
notes.notes:
We've pushed an update today with a number of bug fixes and small tweaks.

Theses include:
* Change: Removed off-screen coins from Seedmore and Globowski
* Change: Reduced number of stars required to play Final Boss  by 5% (from 81 > 75)
* Fix: Linux crash on Bonus Platforms & Switching Scenes
* Fix: Music not looping in end levels
* Fix: Bug with 126 stars instead of 123 (Leaderboard Planet was being counted)
* Fix: No longer will set screen size > native screen resolution 
* Fix: Flickeing on BossHealthBar when filling up
* Fix: Added workaround for WarpDoors triggering when not on door (needs testing / confirmation)
* Fix: Missing text for Japanese and Korean locales
* COOP Fix: Camera would not center properly on all players if player 1 died
* COOP Fix: Players not spaced correctly when respawned at checkpoints
* COOP Fix: Player-On-Player collisions disabled on Easy Mode

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - JumpJet Rex, 20% off!
notes.notes:
JumpJet Rex is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

A punishing, old school 2-D platformer with a time-trial twist! Players take control of a T-Rex with extraterrestrial jump boots, tasked with saving dino-kind from extinction. Jump, drop and dash your way through 40+ challenging levels and race against the clock to preserve life during the Mesozoic era!

*Offer ends April 28 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Update 1 - Shop & Explore
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Thanks for all the really positive feedback so far, we're so happy you guys are enjoying JumpJet Rex.  

We're launching our first update for the game tonight/tomorrow, which will add the [url=http://cl.ly/image/3M2d0t1c3l2F]SHOP to the galaxy map[/url], so you can start customizing your Rex with your hard earned coins.  The shop inventory is random and is run on a 15 minute cooldown timer, so everyone's skins should be quite different! 

The other side to this is we WILL be wiping the leaderboards with this update, but this is because we want everyone's ghosts to be their new rexes and not just a bunch of standard green rex.  We want you to stand out against your competitors.

Lastly, a much requested feature is better navigation of the Galaxy Map, Rex now has free roam controls! If you're not over a planet you can also hold "A" to move faster, we hope you like this change.

Take care and stay awesome,
[url=http://www.twitter.com/mike_gaboury]Mike[/url] & Shawn | Treefortress Games
